title: Building Circuits
intro: The parts of a netlist: elements, sources, behavioural models, semiconductor devices, parameters, subcircuits and model libraries, and how a foundry PDK fits together.

items: Passive Elements and Switches: resistors, capacitors, inductors and coupling, their models and temperature coefficients, initial conditions, and the voltage- and current-controlled switches.
Sources: DC, AC and every transient waveform (PULSE, SIN, EXP, PWL, SFFM, AM, transient noise, random), RF ports, and the four linear controlled sources with their POLY, TABLE and VALUE forms.
Behavioural Modelling: B sources with arbitrary expressions, behavioural R, C and L, Laplace and frequency-table transfer functions, and the XSPICE analog blocks used for system-level models.

Semiconductor Devices and Models: diodes, BJTs, JFETs, MESFETs and MOSFETs, their model levels (from level 1 to BSIM4, BSIM-SOI, HiSIM and VDMOS), model binning, instance parameters and how to read device operating points.
Parameters, Expressions and Functions: .param, braces, .func, the built-in functions, random functions for Monte Carlo, and the scope rules.
Subcircuits and Libraries: .subckt with parameters, hierarchy and multipliers, .include and .lib sections, and library management.
Using a PDK: the SkyWater SKY130, GF180MCU and IHP SG13G2 open PDKs: where the models are, corner sections, the options they need, and a first testbench.
